Implemented type-safe SQL window function helpers, frame utilities, and query builder `WINDOW` clause support on branch `feat/window-functions`:

- **Window Function Helpers** ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts)):
  - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L223-L225), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L227-L229), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L231-L233), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L235-L240), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L242-L244), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L246-L248).
  - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L282-L299), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L301-L318), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L320-L327), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L329-L336), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L338-L349) — typed nullable by default, with [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L282-L299) and [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L301-L318) stripping `null` when a default value is provided.
  - **Window aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L351-L353), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L355-L357), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L359-L372), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L374-L387), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L389-L394).
- **Window Spec & Frame Builders** ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts)):
  - [`WindowFunctionBuilder.over()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L194-L202) supporting empty specs (`over ()`), inline `{ partitionBy, orderBy, frame }` specifications, and named window references (`over "name"` / ``over `name` ``).
  - Frame constructors [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L113-L118) and [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L120-L125) with boundary constants [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L56), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L57), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L58), and boundary functions [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L60-L65) and [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L67-L72).
- **Select Builder `.window(name, spec)` & `WINDOW` Clause Compilation**:
  - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` and `WINDOW` clause compilation before `ORDER BY` across PostgreSQL ([pg-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts#L860-L883), [pg-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts#L403-L447)), MySQL ([mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts#L907-L930), [mysql-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts#L395-L428)), SQLite ([sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts#L708-L731), [sqlite-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts#L374-L389)), SingleStore ([singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts#L780-L803), [singlestore-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts#L374-L401)), and Gel ([gel-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts#L853-L876), [gel-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts#L398-L442)).
- **Top-Level Re-exports & Tests**:
  - Re-exported from [src/sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) through [src/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/src/index.ts) and added unit and type tests in [window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z1e4x0bp/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts).
